text: ECDC, data through 16 Nov: 11,504 confirmed Ebola cases and 5,630 deaths in the DRC. Ituri has 7,858 cases across 28 of 36 health zones. Africa CDC (15 Nov): the outbreak is still not under control six months on.

judge.comment: Figures match the ECDC update recorded in the tracker, with attribution and as-of date. Note the tracker's own lab-confirmed KPI (8,088) uses a different basis than ECDC's count.

factChecks.claim: Ituri 7,858 cases across 28 of 36 health zones
Africa CDC says outbreak still not under control

text: ECDC, datos al 16 nov: 11.504 casos confirmados de ébola y 5.630 muertes en la RDC. Ituri suma 7.858 casos en 28 de 36 zonas sanitarias. Africa CDC (15 nov): el brote sigue sin control tras seis meses.

judge.comment: Spanish version of the verified ECDC digest tweet; figures identical.

text: How much Russian refining is disabled? Ukraine's General Staff: 42.74% (July 2026). IEA: 'more than 20%' at peak. Reuters: national oil processing fell only 3–6%. Three measures, same strikes.

judge.comment: Both sides attributed and not adjudicated. Reuters and IEA as-of dates are not specified in the tracker data, so a human should confirm the dates before publishing.

factChecks.claim: Ukraine's General Staff put disabled capacity at 42.74% in July 2026
IEA said losses were 'more than 20%' at peak
Reuters reported national oil processing fell only 3–6%
